lines.text: @sai_front runs for the last night bus, the doors close, then open again; the driver waves him on.

new_beats.text: @sai_front stops short, doubles over, laughs, then climbs aboard as the doors fold shut.

writes.note: I added a beat where he catches his breath and boards, after the driver waves him on.

reply.rationale: The shot lacked a payoff after the doors reopen, so one timed moment shows his relief and boarding. Words and direction are unchanged.
